project tools for the requested work. When the native fixture MCP is available,

product task. State which operations were observed and which were not.

Include `WF_NATIVE_PACKAGE_GUIDANCE_V1` in the professional report to identify
this exact guidance. This marker alone does not prove loading or execution.
